# ADR-0001: The Xcode project is generated by XcodeGen

- **Status:** Accepted (2026-10-15)

## Context

Silicon Wallet is one multiplatform app target plus a local Swift package. An `.xcodeproj` made
in Xcode's UI can't be reproduced from the command line, and its `project.pbxproj` diffs are
hard to review. Quail already uses XcodeGen successfully.

## Decision

- `project.yml` is the source of the project. `task generate` (XcodeGen) writes
  `SiliconWallet.xcodeproj` and `App/Info.plist`, and both are committed so that Xcode opens
  the repo without extra tools.
- `task generate:check` (part of `task ci:mac`) fails when the committed project is out of date.
- Nobody hand-edits the generated files.

## Consequences

- Contributors need XcodeGen (`brew install xcodegen`) only when they change `project.yml`.
- Xcode features XcodeGen doesn't model need a `settings:` entry or a workaround in `project.yml`.
  For example, the macOS test host path is set there explicitly.
